title: Creamy Celeriac Pasta Bake
description: A comforting and creamy bake featuring celeriac, pasta, and a blend of Mediterranean flavors.
instructions: Toss the celeriac with 1 tbsp of olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast in the oven for 30 minutes, or until tender.
Cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large saucepan, combine the creamy sauce and minced garlic.
Add the roasted celeriac, dried oregano (if using), and cooked pasta to the saucepan.
Stir until well combined and heated through.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish.
Drizzle with the remaining 1 tbsp of olive oil.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly.
